summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with obfuscator.io-style hex-renamed identifiers, a shuffled string-array with a rotation function (WV8StW), and a base64 alphabet decoder — the opaque-loader shape used to hide install-time behavior. setup.mjs itself uses the same obfuscator.io identifier renaming (_0x488df8 / _0x52943e / _0x24db8d) despite being small build-glue. The package is scoped @servicetitan and advertised as an AJAX handler library; the shipped payload is unrelated to that stated purpose and is executed via a second language runtime (Bun) at install time, which also evades Node-only scanners. The alternate-runtime is fetched from an official vendor origin, but the code the runtime is used to execute is a shipped opaque blob whose purpose does not match the package's advertised functionality, and it runs automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
